按照以下步骤，您将快速上手使用系统完整操作整个流程: Follow these steps to quickly get started with the complete workflow
欢迎使用 ODAP 本体设计系统！: Welcome to ODAP Ontology Design System!
本指南将带您完成从工作空间设置到数据应用的完整流程。点击下方步骤，让您开始使用。: This guide will walk you through the complete workflow from workspace setup to data application. Click the steps below to get started.
请在命令行运行: pytest tests/unit/ -v: Run in command line: pytest tests/unit/ -v
示例代码见项目根目录: See project root for example code
创建或选择工作空间和场景: Create or select workspace and scenario
工作空间是所有操作的基础容器。您需要先创建或选择一个工作空间，然后在其中创建场景: Workspace is the base container for all operations. You need to create or select a workspace first, then create scenarios within it.
登录系统（默认账号：admin/admin123）: Log in to the system (default account: admin/admin123)
在顶部导航栏选择或创建工作空间: Select or create a workspace in the top navigation bar
然后选择或创建场景: Then select or create a scenario
这是后续所有操作的基础容器: This is the base container for all subsequent operations
创建实体类型、属性和关系: Create entity types, attributes and relations
在本体设计器中，您可以创建实体类型、定义属性和建立关系。: In the ontology designer, you can create entity types, define attributes and establish relations.
点击右上角新增实体类型按钮: Click the add entity type button in the top right
填写实体类型信息：名称、显示名称、描述、密级: Fill in entity type info: name, display name, description, classification
添加属性：基础属性、统计属性、能力属性: Add attributes: basic, statistical, capability attributes
建立关系：与其他实体类型关联: Establish relations: associate with other entity types
保存并查看关系图预览: Save and preview the relation graph
在蓝图设计器中，您可以设计业务流程，使用各种节点类型来构建数据流。: In the blueprint designer, you can design business processes using various node types to build data flows.
在对象管理页面，您可以查看和管理实体实例。: On the object management page, you can view and manage entity instances.
查看实体列表：表格展示所有实体: View entity list: table showing all entities
查看实体详情：按语义类别分组显示: View entity details: grouped by semantic category
最后，您可以导入数据并开始应用知识图谱。: Finally, you can import data and start applying the knowledge graph.
自动提取实体并添加到知识图谱: Auto-extract entities and add to knowledge graph
点击这里可以随时重新开始引导流程，或查看 API 文档和代码示例。: Click here anytime to restart the guided tour, or view API docs and code examples.
创建或选择工作空间和场景，这是后续所有操作的基础容器。: Create or select a workspace and scenario, the foundation for all subsequent operations.
创建实体类型、定义属性和建立关系，构建知识图谱的骨架。: Create entity types, define attributes and establish relations to build the knowledge graph skeleton.
设计业务流程，使用各种节点类型来构建数据流。: Design business processes using various node types to construct data flows.
导入数据并应用知识图谱，完成从数据到知识的闭环。: Import data and apply the knowledge graph, completing the data-to-knowledge loop.
点击此按钮创建新的工作空间，作为所有资源的顶级容器。: Click this button to create a new workspace, the top-level container for all resources.
切换到场景标签页，管理工作空间下的业务场景。: Switch to the scenario tab to manage business scenarios under this workspace.
在场景标签页中创建新场景，场景是本体和数据的隔离单元。: Create a new scenario in the scenario tab. Scenarios are isolation units for ontologies and data.
点击此按钮新增对象类型，定义实体的属性和关系。: Click this button to add a new object type and define its attributes and relations.
左侧列表展示所有已定义的对象类型，点击可编辑详情。: The left list shows all defined object types. Click to edit details.
右侧面板用于编辑选中类型的属性、关系等详细信息。: The right panel is used to edit attributes, relations and other details of the selected type.
从节点面板中选择需要的节点类型，拖拽到画布中。: Select the required node types from the node panel and drag them onto the canvas.
在画布中拖拽、连接节点，设计业务流程。: Drag and connect nodes on the canvas to design business processes.
设计完成后，点击运行按钮执行蓝图流程。: When design is complete, click the run button to execute the blueprint process.
在类型管理标签页中查看和管理所有对象类型定义。: View and manage all object type definitions in the Type Management tab.
切换到实例标签页，查看和管理实体实例数据。: Switch to the Instances tab to view and manage entity instance data.
使用筛选器按类型、来源、状态过滤实体实例。: Use filters to filter entity instances by type, source, and status.
选择数据摄入方式：文本、新闻、JSON、自然语言、文件上传等。: Select the data ingestion method: text, news, JSON, natural language, file upload, etc.
输入数据后点击此按钮启动摄入流程。: After entering data, click this button to start the ingestion process.
下方表格展示摄入历史记录，可查看构建详情和版本信息。: The table below shows ingestion history; you can view build details and version information.
